triggers.fact: Cummins joined Emerald Technology Ventures as a Limited Partner on August 28, 2026, to expand access to emerging technologies, startup partnerships, and digital tools.
Cummins offers a two-year Marketing and Sales development program in the U.K. and Europe featuring four six-month assignments across multiple business units.
Cummins announced a phased launch plan on August 10, 2026, for its Model Year 2027 X10 and X15 engine platforms.

pain_hypothesis: Managing marketing, sales, and service operations across multiple global business units without a unified CRM and analytics platform risks disjointed customer tracking and siloed data.
